The one thing in here that says something only about me, it says, is that it is unusually negative about land and property. That is the single biggest mistake anybody could make about my life. Everything I have came out of buildings and land. My father built in Brooklyn and Queens, I went into Manhattan, the Grand Hyatt, Trump Tower, Mar-a-Lago, Doral, Turnberry, the golf courses. I did have the Atlantic City years and the debt in 1990, and I have been in court over what my properties are worth, and I am not going to pretend that was nothing. But land is what made me. Whoever wrote this had it exactly backwards, and it is the one line they said to test it on, so test it there and it fails.

Home and mother in the same sentence as property, that is a strange thing to read. My mother was ill after my youngest brother was born and I was very young, and my father was the one who was there. So half of that line lands and the other half does not.

Debts and rivals reading hard, that one I will give them. Nineteen ninety I had personally guaranteed close to a billion dollars and the banks were in my office every week. And rivals, well, I have had more people come after me than anyone. Two impeachments, four indictments, a conviction, and a man on a roof in Butler, Pennsylvania. So they got that.

The temperament page, steady, self-reliant, happier leading than following. Sure. That is also every single person who would ever pay for one of these. It is the horoscope in the newspaper. Marriage mixed, I have been married three times, of course it is mixed, anybody who reads a newspaper knows that.

What it misses is the whole shape of it. It says right now is an ordinary stretch. I got shot in the ear in July, I was elected President of the United States four months later, and I was sworn in again in January. There is nothing ordinary about that stretch and nothing in this page saw it coming.
